title: Beyond Inference: Performance Analysis of DNN Server Overheads for Computer Vision
problem: End-to-end DNN vision applications suffer from substantial performance bottlenecks in server overheads including data movement, preprocessing (decompression, resizing, normalization), and message brokers between DNNs. These overheads can constitute up to 56% of end-to-end latency and approximately 80% of throughput impact, yet are conventionally overlooked in deep learning system design.
motivation: Optimizing end-to-end vision inference performance requires understanding server-side bottlenecks beyond the DNN computation itself, as these overlooked overheads dominate performance in production data-center deployments.
method: The paper conducts a thorough empirical evaluation of computer vision inference requests on a throughput-optimized serving system, quantifying performance impacts of data movement, preprocessing operations, and message brokers across multiple vision tasks (classification, segmentation, detection, depth-estimation). They measure latency and throughput contributions across different image sizes and complex multi-DNN processing pipelines with varying output rates.
key_novelty: Empirically demonstrates that data processing and movement functions dominate end-to-end performance (up to 56% latency, ~80% throughput impact) in vision inference systems, contradicting conventional accelerator-centric optimization approaches.
contributions: Comprehensive evaluation quantifying server overheads (data movement, preprocessing, message brokers) across diverse computer vision tasks and pipelines
Identification of performance bottlenecks dominated by data processing rather than DNN inference computation
2.25× throughput improvement versus prior serving systems through holistic design addressing identified bottlenecks
Evidence motivating shift from accelerator-focused to system-level optimization in deep learning system design

metrics.other: Data processing: 56% of end-to-end latency; data movement: ~80% throughput impact on large images

primary_theme: Server overhead analysis in vision inference
